title: OpenAI claims ChatGPT’s new default model hallucinates way less
raw_excerpt: OpenAI's newest default model for ChatGPT might not make stuff up as much. Hallucinations have been an ongoing problem for AI models, but OpenAI says its new GPT-5.5 Instant model has "significant improvements in factuality across the board." The company claims that, based on "internal evaluations," GPT-5.5 Instant produced "52.5% fewer hallucinated claims" than its Instant model for GPT-5.3 "on high-stakes prompts covering areas like medicine, law, and finance." GPT-5.5 Instant also "reduced inaccurate claims by 37.3% on especially challenging conversations users had flagged for factual errors." summary: OpenAI 宣布 ChatGPT 默认模型升级为 GPT-5.5 Instant，在医学、法律、金融等高难度场景中，幻觉率降低 52.5%，用户标记的事实错误减少 37.3%。该模型还改进了个性化控制和记忆功能，是 OpenAI 在提升模型可靠性方面的重要进展。

title: Apple agrees to pay iPhone owners $250 million for not delivering AI Siri
raw_excerpt: Apple has agreed to pay $250 million to settle a class action lawsuit that accused it of misleading customers about the availability of its Apple Intelligence features. The proposed settlement would apply to people in the US who purchased all models of the iPhone 16 and the iPhone 15 Pro between June 10th, 2024 and March 29th, 2025. People who submit qualifying claims can receive $25 for each eligible device, "which may decrease or increase up to $95 per device, depending on claim volume and other factors," according to Clarkson Law Firm , the legal team behind the class action lawsuit. The settlement will resolve a 2025 lawsuit , alleging  … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: 苹果同意支付 2.5 亿美元和解一项集体诉讼，该诉讼指控苹果在 Apple Intelligence 功能可用性上误导消费者。2024 年 6 月至 2025 年 3 月期间购买 iPhone 16 和 iPhone 15 Pro 的美国用户可获赔，每台设备 25 至 95 美元。

title: Microsoft gives up on Xbox Copilot AI
raw_excerpt: Xbox is "winding down Copilot on mobile" and "will stop development of Copilot on console," new Xbox CEO Asha Sharma announced on Tuesday. The move follows Sharma's reorganization of the Xbox platform team earlier on Tuesday, which added executives from Microsoft's CoreAI team - where Sharma worked before taking over Xbox - to the Xbox side of the company. Sharma, on X : Xbox needs to move faster, deepen our connection with the community, and address friction for both players and developers. summary: Xbox 新任 CEO Asha Sharma 宣布停止 Xbox Copilot 移动端和主机端开发，并重组平台团队，从微软 CoreAI 团队引入高管。此举标志着微软在游戏领域 AI 助手的战略收缩，转而聚焦核心体验。

title: Book publishers sue Meta over AI’s ‘word-for-word’ copying
raw_excerpt: Meta is facing a class action lawsuit filed by five major book publishers and one author over claims the company "engaged in one of the most massive infringements of copyrighted materials in history" when training its Llama AI models, as reported earlier by The New York Times . In their suit , Macmillan, McGraw Hill, Elsevier, Hachette, Cengage, and author Scott Turow allege that Meta "repeatedly copied" their books and journal articles without permission. summary: 五大出版商（Macmillan、McGraw Hill 等）及作家 Scott Turow 起诉 Meta，指控其在训练 Llama 模型时大规模侵权，从 LibGen、Sci-Hub 等盗版网站复制受版权保护的书籍和文章。诉讼称这是“历史上最大规模的版权侵权之一”。

title: Google, Microsoft, and xAI will allow the US government to review their new AI models
raw_excerpt: Google DeepMind, Microsoft, and Elon Musk's xAI have agreed to allow the US government to review new AI models before they're released to the public. In an announcement on Tuesday , the Commerce Department's Center for AI Standards and Innovation (CAISI) says it will work with the AI companies to perform "pre-deployment evaluations and targeted research to better assess frontier AI capabilities." CAISI, which started evaluating models from OpenAI and Anthropic in 2024 , says it has performed 40 reviews so far. summary: Google DeepMind、微软和 xAI 同意让美国商务部 CAISI 中心在 AI 模型公开发布前进行审查。CAISI 此前已对 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的模型进行过 40 次评估，此次扩展至更多公司，标志着美国政府对前沿 AI 监管的加强。

title: Apple could let you pick a favorite AI model in iOS 27
raw_excerpt: The next update to Apple's operating systems could allow users to choose their preferred AI model for running Apple Intelligence. According to Bloomberg 's Mark Gurman, Apple is planning to allow third-party chatbots to power its AI features system-wide in iOS 27, iPadOS 27, and macOS 27, all expected for this fall. In addition to running Siri , compatible third-party AI models, called "Extensions," will also now be able to run other Apple Intelligence features like Writing Tools and Image Playground. According to Gurman, Apple will also allow users to choose different Siri voices for different AI models - Siri responses from one of Apple's  … Read the full story at The Verge.
summary: 据 Bloomberg 的 Mark Gurman 报道，苹果计划在 iOS 27 中允许用户选择第三方 AI 模型作为 Apple Intelligence 的默认引擎，包括 Siri、写作工具和 Image Playground。此举将打破苹果封闭生态，为用户提供更多 AI 选择。

title: OpenAI is reportedly launching a phone for ChatGPT
raw_excerpt: OpenAI's first hardware product might be a phone instead of a mysterious Jony Ive gadget . As reported by MacRumors , supply chain analyst Ming-Chi Kuo shared details about the rumored phone, claiming OpenAI is "fast-tracking" it and aiming to start mass production in early 2027. According to Kuo, the phone will run on a "customized version of the [MediaTek] Dimensity 9600," which is expected to launch this fall and follow up the Dimensity 9500 currently powering phones like the Vivo X300 Pro and the Oppo Find X9 Pro . summary: 供应链分析师郭明錤透露，OpenAI 正在加速开发自有品牌手机，计划 2027 年初量产。该手机将采用定制版联发科 Dimensity 9600 芯片，重点优化 ISP 以支持 AI 拍照功能。这标志着 OpenAI 从软件向硬件的重大拓展。

title: Anthropic and OpenAI Launch Enterprise AI Ventures
raw_excerpt: Anthropic and OpenAI both announced separate enterprise AI ventures backed by major financial firms, with Anthropic's valued at $1.5B and OpenAI's targeting a $10B valuation.
summary: Anthropic 和 OpenAI 分别宣布成立企业 AI 合资公司，由大型金融机构支持。Anthropic 的合资公司估值 15 亿美元，OpenAI 的目标估值达 100 亿美元。这显示 AI 巨头正加速通过资本合作拓展企业市场。

title: Anthropic is working on Orbit, its upcoming proactive assistant
raw_excerpt: Orbit is a briefing and insights system in Claude and Claude Code that can produce personalized briefings with actionable insights drawn from connected work tools. Anthropic's Code with Claude developer conference will be held in San Francisco on May 6, London on May 19, and Tokyo on June 10. It is uncertain whether Orbit will be formally unveiled on stage or quietly rolled out.
summary: Anthropic 正在开发名为 Orbit 的主动式 AI 助手，集成于 Claude 和 Claude Code，可从连接的工作工具中生成个性化简报和可操作洞察。Orbit 可能于 5 月 6 日的“Code with Claude”开发者大会上正式发布。

title: Tuna-2 (GitHub Repo)
raw_excerpt: Tuna-2 outperforms both Tuna-R and Tuna across a diverse suite of multimodal benchmarks by using pixel embeddings. Meta plans to only release a foundation checkpoint rather than the full production-trained model weights. The release will have a small number of layers removed from both the LLM backbone and the diffusion head, but the remaining layers and all other components are fully preserved. Examples of images generated by the model are available in the repository.
summary: Meta 开源 Tuna-2，一种基于像素嵌入的多模态模型，在多项基准上超越前代 Tuna 和 Tuna-R。Meta 将发布基础检查点（移除少量层），保留大部分权重。该模型展示了像素级嵌入在图像生成和理解中的潜力。
